web-guide-idea-89.audience: Readers who want guidance and discussion around a religious text.
web-guide-idea-89.offer: Offer context and a thoughtful reading of a chosen passage. Explain the tradition and interpretation you are using.
web-guide-idea-89.steps.0: Send the passage reference and preparation note.
web-guide-idea-89.steps.1: Read manageable sections and explain context.
web-guide-idea-89.steps.2: Invite questions and compare interpretations respectfully.
web-guide-idea-89.equipment: A phone and the relevant text. Share only material you have permission to reproduce.
web-guide-idea-89.returnReason: Progress through a text at a clear pace, with each session addressing a distinct passage.
web-guide-idea-89.promotion: Publish the reading reference and your relevant background.
